column1: # Authors whose two surnames are joined by "y": Spanish double surnames, one person each
# ("Bolívar y Pieltain", "Dusmet y Alonso"). An authorship "X y Y" joins into one author only when
# the pair is listed here; any other "y" separates two people ("Spix y Agassiz"), as in Java.
# See resources/README.md for how the list was built and how to extend it.
# Columns, tab-separated: surnames as cited, Wikidata item, IPNI author id, ZooBank author id,
# other spellings seen in the data ("|"-separated). A pair is matched on the word before the "y"
# and the first word after it that is no particle ("de", "del", "la"), case and accents ignored,
# so "Bolivar y Pieltain" needs no line of its own; misspellings and abbreviations do.
